name: exists with current_user
body: RETURN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.sec.user_region m WHERE m.region = region_key AND m.user_email = current_user())

name: in list with group
body: region_key IN (SELECT m.region FROM main.sec.map m WHERE is_account_group_member(m.grp))

name: quoted names and user or group on one column
body: exists(select 1 from `main`.`sec`.`map` m where m.region = region_key and (m.grp = current_user() or is_account_group_member(m.grp)))

name: extra predicate refused
body: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.sec.map m WHERE m.region = region_key AND m.user_email = current_user() AND m.active)

name: other key refused
body: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.sec.map m WHERE m.region = other AND m.user_email = current_user())

name: mixed principal columns refused
body: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.sec.map m WHERE m.region = region_key AND m.a = current_user() OR m.b = current_user())

name: case expression refused
body: CASE WHEN is_account_group_member('x') THEN true ELSE region_key = 'EU' END

name: union refused
body: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.sec.map m WHERE m.region = region_key AND m.user_email = current_user() UNION SELECT 1)
